item.title: test(sqlite): stop forwarding lstat options in snapshot inspection mock
item.summary: test(sqlite): stop forwarding lstat options in snapshot inspection mock Reverts the arg-forwarding change from #121696: forwarding bigint options shifts which publication-identity lstat the injected EIO lands on, and on Windows the snapshot fails with 'publication source identity did not match' instead of the inspection failure under test, breaking checks-windows-node-test deterministically. Restore the previously Windows-green single-argument forwarding with a comment explaining why.
